svg.title: opm and TEI Publisher: two siblings built on the TEI Processing Model
svg.desc: Animated overview in four steps: 1. a TEI document and an ODD with processing model rules produce the same rendered output, whichever tool runs them; 2. TEI Publisher compiles the ODD to XQuery and runs in the eXist-db database, opm compiles it to Python and needs no database; both share the same ODD files, Jinks templates, profiles, fragments and pagination; 3. both turn a TEI document and its ODD into single files such as HTML, PDF or EPUB with the same result; 4. for complete websites, TEI Publisher builds a dynamic, database-backed site that renders pages on request, while opm renders a static site in advance that can be hosted on any web server; opm can also pre-render pages for TEI Publisher.

g.text: = same result, whichever tool runs it
